description: Simultaneously grow three sequences S, T and A starting with S(1)=T(1)=a(1)=2. Search for the smallest integer m in S so that one of its multiples k*m is larger than T(n) and closer to T(n) than (k-1)*m. If this is true, a(n+1) = m and T(n+1) = k*m. Otherwise, add the smallest positive integer, m, to S that holds this property.
